name: Xatt l-Aħmar Reef
description: Reef along the south side of Xatt l-Aħmar bay, from the same entry as the three wrecks. A long snorkel out leads to a drop-off with boulders, nooks and crannies, small groupers, octopus and bream.
conditions: A good option when a north-westerly wind closes other sites. A 4x4 helps on the dirt track.
